title: Unit-normalized finite scalar transport on an open slice
statement: Fix l, E, the open immersion j:U→X and Operations o of [def-sf-open-semilinear-tensor-model-data]. At any finite level n, let D be a normalized SystemScalarModel of [lem-pur-system-scalar-model] for the completed-to-finite coefficient projection restricted to the open slice. There is a natural isomorphism η from scalar extension on U followed by the supplied finite coefficient equivalence to the supplied integral coefficient equivalence followed by D.model.E. On every original slice section x, η inverse sends D's ordinary scalar-adjunction unit applied to the integral forward-functor transport of x to the finite forward-functor transport of the ordinary scalar unit of x. No extension-by-zero comparison or uniqueness of such comparisons is asserted.

source.place: Tags 03CZ and 03DI; unit-transport substep of the finite open scalar comparison.

proof.text: Use o.projections n to construct the scalar-restriction square by identity maps on sections. Their linearity is the projection equation evaluated on a scalar. Insert the specified integral and finite forward-functor equalities.

Apply the normalized adjunction comparison across the supplied coefficient equivalences, using the ordinary scalar adjunction on U and D.ordinaryAdj on the slice. Its inverse comparison satisfies the unit equation.

Evaluate the unit equation on a slice section. The scalar-restriction square acts as the identity on the original section. Naturality of the integral forward-functor cast moves the scalar unit past it; cancel the inverse casts to obtain the stated original-section formula.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03CZ and 03DI; explicit identity scalar-restriction square and normalized adjunction comparison.

theorem exists_openFiniteScalarUnitTransport (o : Operations l E j) (n : ℕ)
    (D : SheafOfModules.SystemScalarModel.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1)}
      (((ProEt.topology X).overPullback CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}
        (IntegralOpenReduction.openObject j)).map
          (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted l E X n))) :
    ∃ η : scalarReductionExtension l E U n ⋙ (o.finite n).functor ≅
        o.integral.functor ⋙ D.model.E,
      ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E U)
        (W : Over (IntegralOpenReduction.openObject j))
        (x : M.val.obj (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite j).obj W))),
        (η.inv.app M).val.app (op W)
            ((D.ordinaryAdj.unit.app (o.integral.functor.obj M)).val.app (op W)
              (((eqToHom o.integralFunctor.symm).app M).val.app (op W) x)) =
          ((eqToHom (o.finiteFunctor n).symm).app
            ((scalarReductionExtension l E U n).obj M)).val.app (op W)
              (coefficientIntegralScalarUnitSection l E U n M
                (op ((IntegralOpenReduction.sliceSite j).obj W)) x)
